item_short_desc: The Smith & Wesson Extreme OPS Knife is great for fishing, hunting, camping, and emergencies. The knife 7 1/2” overall, and has a 3 ¼” 400 Series Stainless Steel locking blade. The Extreme OPS Knife also has an aluminum handle, and a pocket clip.
